NBA DFS Picks for Tuesday, November 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Tuesday, November 10 · 5 games · First game 7:30 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 10, 9:31 AM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) is the top-projected player on the Tuesday, November 10 DraftKings main slate at 57.3 DraftKings points for $11,400. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 49.6, $10,100) and Karl-Anthony Towns (NYK, 49.2, $8,900) are next.

Brayden Burries (MIL) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.71 projected points per $1,000 at $4,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 10, 9:31 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
